title: plexWell LP384 Part 1
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol accomplishes Step 1 (Sample-Barcoding, SB, Reaction Set-up). During this protocol, 6µL of input DNA in each well of two 96-well plates is transferred to the SBP96 plate containing specific reagents. 5µL of Coding Buffer (3X) is then added to each well of the SBP96 plate. --- * [plexWell LP 384 Kit](https://seqwell.com/products/plexwell-lp-384/) - SBP96 Plate - Coding Buffer (3X) * [Opentrons P10 Multi Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Bio-Rad 96-Well Plate, 200µL PCR](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr?category=wellPlate), containing samples * [NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL](https://labware.opentrons.com/nest_12_reservoir_15ml?category=reservoir) * [Opentrons 10µL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-filter-tip) --- Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the plexWell LP384 Kit (including SBP96 plate and Coding Buffer (3X)), Opentrons P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette, Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plates containing samples, NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir, and Opentrons 10 µL filter tip racks.

steps.title: Load deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place Opentrons 10 µL filter tip racks in slots 1, 4, 7, and 10. Load the first Bio‑Rad 96‑well plate with samples into slot 2 (Source 1) and the second identical plate into slot 5 (Source 2). Load the SBP96 destination plates into slots 3 (Destination 1) and 6 (Destination 2). Load the NEST 12‑well reservoir containing Coding Buffer (3X) into slot 9, using column 1 for the buffer.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, specify that 6 µL of input DNA will be transferred from each well of the two source plates to the corresponding well of the SBP96 plates, and that 5 µL of Coding Buffer (3X) will be added to each well after the DNA transfer.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons protocol builder (or the provided link) to generate the Python protocol for Part 1, then download the protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT app
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons app, select “Upload Protocol”, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons app for each tip rack, source plate, destination plate, and reservoir using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Run sample‑barcoding reaction
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons app. The robot will (a) transfer 6 µL DNA from each well of the two source plates to the corresponding wells of the SBP96 plates, and (b) add 5 µL Coding Buffer (3X) to each well of the SBP96 plates.
